method: Accelerated COMPLETE production frame, explicit dt .25 s, normal input vector, real controllers/collisions/streaming/audio/rig. Rendering only at checkpoints; not a native film or FPS test. Diagnostic source-road placement only BEFORE traversal except spawn which is untouched. No position assignment or collider alteration during travel.

chosen.selectionNote: Prior actual controller trace supplies STEERING TARGETS ONLY. Initial source placement before trial, then normal car controls exclusively own the position. No replayed root or speed. All source admission and collisions remain active. Declared out-and-back journey with an actual multi-point turn on the admitted two-way road; return source graph respects one-way edges. Its physical result is not implied by this plan.
